suppress.notes: False positive: matched via the generic "opentelemetry:opentelemetry" CPE (LOW confidence), which also covers the Go and C++ OpenTelemetry implementations and unrelated .NET packages (OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Jaeger, OpenTelemetry.Api, OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Propagators). Azure.Monitor.OpenTelemetry.AspNetCore is not affected by any of these.

False positive: matched via the generic "opentelemetry:opentelemetry" CPE (LOW confidence), which also covers the Go and C++ OpenTelemetry implementations and unrelated .NET packages (OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Jaeger, OpenTelemetry.Api, OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Propagators). Not exploitable: image-size is only pulled in transitively by datauri, a devDependency used by the webpack build plugins (data-uri-favicon-html-webpack-plugin, add-inline-styles-html-webpack-plugin) to inline assets that are committed to this repository. Both advisories are denial of service through an infinite loop when parsing a crafted JXL/HEIF/ICNS image, which requires attacker controlled input at runtime. Nothing shipped to the browser depends on image-size, and the build only ever parses our own files. No fixed version exists for either advisory.
